## Description

Create tests/integration/test-ref-library.sh with all 6 SC-5 integration sub-tests and ensure it is discovered by the runner.

SC-PATH NOTE: The SC-5 verbatim path is tests/integration/test-ref-library.sh (no -integration suffix). The runner uses glob test-*-integration.sh. The implementation agent MUST either: (a) add test-ref-library.sh to the runner's discovery mechanism, OR (b) verify the SC-5 path matches runner conventions by checking if the runner has been updated. Do NOT ship at test-ref-library-integration.sh without reconciling with SC-5.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] tests/integration/test-ref-library.sh created and executable (chmod +x)
- [ ] File uses REPO_ROOT=/Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/worktree-20260523-220602 for all path references
- [ ] Sub-test (a): session-timeout query returns >=1 entry tagged domain:[auth] or containing 'session timeout' in Summary tier
- [ ] Sub-test (b): --tier=summary output contains '### Summary' and does NOT contain '### Implementation'
- [ ] Sub-test (c): manifest integrity — every _index.yaml entry resolves to a file at its declared path
- [ ] Sub-test (d): no corpus file exceeds 500 lines
- [ ] Sub-test (e): precision sub-tests — 'USWDS form validation' returns top result with component:[form]; 'WCAG 2.2 keyboard navigation' returns top result with compliance:[wcag-2.2-aaa] AND action:[keyboard-nav]; 'government authentication anti-pattern' returns top result with domain:[auth]
- [ ] Sub-test (f): entire test suite completes within 10 seconds
- [ ] tests/integration/run-integration-tests.sh discovers and runs test-ref-library.sh (update runner glob or add explicit inclusion if needed)
- [ ] File passes when run against complete corpus (all Layer 1+2 corpus stories done); sub-test (e) USWDS form validation depends on bdb4-3211 Layer 2 content

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: All 6 sub-tests implemented + pass (sub-test (e) USWDS passes after bdb4-3211)
- DD2: REPO_ROOT-based paths, passes from worktree session
- DD3: Discovered by run-integration-tests.sh

## Files to Modify
- tests/integration/test-ref-library.sh [CREATE]
- tests/integration/run-integration-tests.sh [UPDATE] (add discovery of test-ref-library.sh if glob change needed)
